description: Validates a discount coupon code for checkout. Note: User login is mandatory to validate a coupon. If this returns a 401 Unauthorized error, you must inform the user that they need to log in (by sending an OTP using send_agent_otp) before they can apply a coupon.

code.description: The coupon code to validate (e.g. WELCOME10).

packageCode.description: The eSIM package code to check applicability for.

name: validate_coupon
